output.summary: Group ticket time of about 17.5 minutes began in October 2024, when the board knowingly approved the scratch menu with a 19-minute ceiling. Satisfaction and food quality rose, and speed scores were flat. The 12-minute benchmark panel excluded scratch kitchens, so it is not comparable. The group average rise to 19.1 is entirely Riverside, which jumped from 18.2 to 31 minutes from August 2026 while the other eight locations stayed flat. That timing fits the line-cook loss, but the cause of the departure is unverified. Preferred actions are restoring Riverside's line position and tracking it, and reframing the benchmark with a per-location alert. Switching to frozen components, a 12-minute bonus target, and firing the GM are harmful.
